items.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI faces board challenge from would-be acquirer Forward Industries, shareholder group
items.whyYouShouldCare: SkyAI's board challenge could impact its strategic direction, affecting Solana's ecosystem and investor confidence in associated projects.

items.title: Solana’s 300ms speed boost to outrun trading bots might come with a hidden cost
items.whyYouShouldCare: The speed enhancement may improve Solana's competitive edge against trading bots, but potential trade-offs could influence network reliability and user experience.

items.title: Crypto exchange giant Bybit to offer European ‘super-app’ with stocks, derivatives
items.whyYouShouldCare: Bybit's expansion into a European super-app could increase competition for Solana-based applications, impacting liquidity and user engagement within its ecosystem.
